doc.title: Marilyn Crispell interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, January 21, 2022

title: Duo recording with Georg Graewe on detuned pianos
summary: A piano factory tuner offered unusual tunings for her duo album with Graewe, which sounds like music from outer space.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: Record labels, producers and the business of making albums

blocks.x: I’m trying to think if it was an album you did, apparently some of the album had two pianos that were not in tune on purpose.
Yeah. Wow, you know that one.
Where did that idea come from?

Well that was with this German pianist Georg Graewe and we just had the idea to do a duo recording. We went to this piano factory to look at pianos and the master tuner there said he was working with all these different tunings and would we like to try something with one of those tunings, and we said yes. That’s how that came about. And I love that recording. It sounds like music from outer space.
